description: Implement the browser automation core: session management, job page navigation, Easy Apply logic, external site form-filling logic, and the CLI entry point that ties everything together. This is the main application logic.
steps: Create src/naukri_apply/browser.py with BrowserManager class: launches Playwright Chromium with persistent context (user_data_dir for session reuse), configures viewport/user-agent, provides async context manager for clean setup/teardown. Include a method to check if user is logged in by looking for profile elements on naukri.com.

Create src/naukri_apply/applicator.py with JobApplicator class: takes a page and a job URL, navigates to it, extracts job metadata (company name, title, location) from the listing page DOM using Naukri's known selectors (e.g., .jd-header-title, .company-name, .location). Determines apply type: looks for 'Apply' or 'Easy Apply' button vs external redirect indicators. Returns a JobListing model.

Create src/naukri_apply/easy_apply.py with EasyApplyHandler class: clicks the Easy Apply button, handles any confirmation dialogs or chatbot questionnaire that Naukri shows (simple yes/no or selection questions), waits for success confirmation message, returns ApplicationResult with status.

Create src/naukri_apply/external_apply.py with ExternalApplyHandler class: after clicking apply that opens external site, detects common ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, custom forms). Implements form-filling logic: finds input fields by common name/id/label patterns (name, email, phone, resume/cv upload, linkedin, experience), fills them from UserProfile. If account creation is needed (detected by signup/register form), fills email/password. Handles file upload for resume. Returns ApplicationResult.

Create src/naukri_apply/form_filler.py with utility functions: find_field_by_patterns(page, field_type) that tries multiple selector strategies (label text, input name/id, placeholder text) to locate form fields. fill_text_field(locator, value), upload_file(locator, file_path), select_dropdown(locator, value). These are reusable primitives for form automation.

Create src/naukri_apply/main.py with the CLI using Click: commands 'apply' (takes --urls-file or --url for single URL, --config path), 'check-session' (verifies login status). The apply command: loads config, initializes browser, iterates URLs, for each: navigate, detect type, attempt apply, log result to CSV. Includes error handling and graceful shutdown.
Create src/naukri_apply/__main__.py so the package is runnable via python -m naukri_apply
Create tests/test_applicator.py with unit tests that mock Playwright page objects to test metadata extraction logic
Create tests/test_form_filler.py with unit tests for field-finding pattern matching logic
Install playwright and chromium browser: source .venv/bin/activate && playwright install chromium
Run the full test suite: source .venv/bin/activate && pytest tests/ -v
Verify CLI help works: source .venv/bin/activate && python -m naukri_apply --help
acceptance_criteria: BrowserManager launches and closes Playwright browser cleanly
JobApplicator correctly identifies Easy Apply vs External apply scenarios
ExternalApplyHandler can detect form fields and fill basic information
FormFiller utilities handle multiple selector strategies for finding fields
CLI entry point shows help text and accepts --urls-file and --config arguments
All existing and new tests pass with pytest
